definitions.explanation: Having a quality that overwhelms or frightens others through display of power or dominance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{萎縮|いしゅく}→萎縮：07526_ishuku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I felt intimidated by his overbearing attitude.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a building with an intimidating atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{威圧的|いあつてき}で⟦{話|はな}しかけ→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧⟦づらい→〜づらい：18368_zurai⟧。
examples.english: My boss is intimidating, so it's hard to approach them.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{威圧|いあつ}→威圧：09165_iatsu⟧ (intimidation, coercion) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な＋noun (attributive)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}に＋verb (adverbial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (intimidating attitude)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (intimidating atmosphere)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧ (intimidating gaze)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}に⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧ (to treat in an intimidating manner)

RELATED TERMS:

・⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧ - high-handed, overbearing
